name: GalaxyFrenia
source:
A dating sim from outerspace!

The story of you and your comrade Harmony on adventures in space when she gets sick and you two end up going into a blackhole visiting new planets that will show you the truth.

Go into the Spaceship with Harmony and Emperador and discover your past and all you forgot, meet people whom you had never seen before and try hide from the creatures that follow you since you get into the blackhole.

[From [url=https://leporisstudios.itch.io/galaxyfrenia]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
来自外太空的恋爱模拟游戏！

讲述你与同伴哈莫妮在太空冒险途中，因她突发重病而阴差阳错双双坠入黑洞，造访一颗颗未知行星并揭晓真相的故事。

与哈莫妮及恩佩拉多一同登上飞船，找回你被遗忘的过往与身世，邂逅素未谋面的各色人物，并设法躲避自坠入黑洞起便一路尾随你们的诡异生物吧。

[摘自[url=https://leporisstudios.itch.io/galaxyfrenia]itch.io[/url]]
